  • looking for artists/designers

    FOURTHSENTINELSSINS
    so is anyone willing to make a v1 design for my w.i.p utau "himeloid" (aka princessloid)? im kinda tired from drawing a bunch and it's especially annoying to digitally draw full body art without a lineless artstyle (i usually want to mimic kei's artstyle or a more anime-ish artstyle in general) id prefer the art to be in a close style to (or in the exact same style as) kei's artstyle, like the artstyle used in the original hatsune miku official art, kasane teto's art, or momo momone's art, but it's totally okay if it's not. someone else who is able to draw like that can also draw the official art after the official design is accepted, but this isnt completely necessary :) to get an idea of what you should draw, i want her to be an elegant princess with lots of pink, yellow, and red. she might have a similar outfit to ritsu namine. she'll have strawberry blonde hair the same style as tei sukone's and her character item is a pink teddy bear with a yellow ribbon around its neck. her personality is sweet yet spoiled. shes used to getting what she wants, so shes pretty inconsiderate, but she still tries to be kind and loyal to others. when i say shes spoiled i mean shes very spoiled, since shes a princess (hence her name being "himeloid" which translates to "princessloid") all credits will be given to the designer and artist. as said before they can be separate people or not.

  • A little bit about Verdexa Rei and the journey of its progress..

    Nazwagodean
    I used a translation tool for this text, so please bear with any odd phrasing the original was in Indonesian. So, I’d like to share a little about Verdexa Rei, a character I’ve patiently brought to life. It wasn't born out of a sudden, heated impulse far from it?!! She didn't actually start with a voice.. initially, I just drew a kawaii mecha robot that was the extent of it. I was happy with the design, but I kept thinking about how, someday, she might have a voice of her own. A sense of envy drove me to give it a try. I thought, "If others can do it, why can't I?" So, I started recording my own voice and working on a small project what I like to call "slow but steady progress." I edited my recordings to give them that kawaii robot like quality. I’m still working on the project to this day.. that’s why I enjoy creating short, 30 s conversations and original songs, even if they aren't popular yet.
    00

  • 🌙 Looking for a Voice Provider for Dreamyloid! 🌙

    SnowCreators
    Hello! I am looking for someone who would like to participate as the voice provider for my UTAU character Dreamyloid :D This project will be a voicebank for UTAU, used for songs, covers, music videos, and character stories. 🎤 Voicebank information Type: CV or CVVC (up to the voice provider) Language: Japanese Software: UTAU Use: songs and creative projects 🌙 About Dreamyloid Name: Dreamyloid (“Dreamy” from the dreamy aesthetic + inspiration from voice synthesis software like Vocaloid) Power: 🌙 Dream Travel She can travel through the world of dreams, but if she uses this power too much, she may become trapped inside them. Personality: Cute, gentle, and a little silly, but with a hidden sad and mysterious side. Voice concept: A cute, light, and fast voice made for sweet, fun songs and also creepy/dark songs. Species: 90% human, 10% chimera Age: 14–18 (can be decided by the voice provider) Item: 🍬 Cotton candy Inspiration: a youthful, cute, and dreamy aesthetic. 🎧 Want to help with the voice? You don't need to know how to draw or create a character! I will handle the design, lore, and concept — you only need to provide the voice :D Samples can be sent: as separate files or organized by syllable groups (example: ka ke ki ko ku) 💬 Project Discord Community We have a Discord server for: 🎨 Fanarts 🎤 People interested in trying to provide the voice 🌙 Project updates Join here: https://discord.gg/WrRt2GeXu 🔒 Privacy: The voice will only be used for the Dreamyloid project, with credits given to the voice provider. No personal information is required besides Discord and voice recordings. Thank you for reading! 🌙✨

    Privacy Preference Center

    When you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences, or your device, and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect. The information does not usually identify you directly, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Because we respect your right to privacy, you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to learn more and change our default settings. Blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.
    Privacy Policy

    Manage Consent Preferences

    Strictly Necessary Cookies

    Always Active

    These cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not then work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.

    Performance Cookies

    Always Active

    These cookies allow us to count visits and traffic sources so we can measure and improve the performance of our site. They help us to know which pages are the most and least popular and see how visitors move around the site. All information these cookies collect is aggregated and therefore anonymous. If you do not allow these cookies we will not know when you have visited our site, and will not be able to monitor its performance.

    Functional Cookies

    Always Active

    These cookies enable the website to provide enhanced functionality and personalisation. They may be set by us or by third party providers whose services we have added to our pages. If you do not allow these cookies then some or all of these services may not function properly.

    Targeting Cookies

    Always Active

    These cookies may be set through our site by our advertising partners. They may be used by those companies to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant adverts on other sites. They do not store directly personal information, but are based on uniquely identifying your browser and internet device. If you do not allow these cookies, you will experience less targeted advertising.

    Social Media Cookies

    Always Active

    These cookies are set by a range of social media services that we have added to the site to enable you to share our content with your friends and networks. They are capable of tracking your browser across other sites and building up a profile of your interests. This may impact the content and messages you see on other websites you visit. If you do not allow these cookies you may not be able to use or see these sharing tools.
